choices.content: Add the widths of all the classes

Count the data values falling within each class

question.prompt: When 20 data values are grouped using a class width of 5, how are the frequencies obtained?

solutions.explanation: The frequency is the number of data values falling within a particular class. Assign each data value to its corresponding class, then count them.
solutions.title: Apply the definition of class frequency
